# Apollo desktop integration packages

These tarballs were produced from immutable commit
`0f4a4d992baba6953274e488e98d9e2f5cfd2682` in
`ROMERUU-dev/apollo-reception-macos`.

The packages are consumed through repository-local `file:` dependencies and
locked with npm integrity hashes. They are generated artifacts, not manually
copied source. Refreshing them requires a reviewed native commit followed by
`npm run build` and `npm pack` for each workspace package.
